concerns.text: T002 is tagged [P] and listed as parallel with T001, but its own text creates a hidden ordering dependency: it must 'abort loudly ... if unavailable and the deviation is not ratified', reading the ratification record `data/provenance/spec_plan_deviation.json` that only T001 writes. If T002 runs before T001 completes, the ratification file is absent and the abort condition is indeterminate. Either make T002 depend on T001, or have T002 read the ratified amendment document/spec directly rather than a T001-produced artifact.
